senses.definition: Pertaining to or founded on experiment.
(sciences) Serving to be experimented upon; used in an experiment.

quotes.text: Brown-Séquard, noting that Addison's disease involved the failure of the adrenal (or suprarenal) glands near the kidneys, removed them in experimental animals, and thus proved they were necessary for life […].
quotes.reference: 1997, Roy Porter, The Greatest Benefit to Mankind, Folio Society, published 2016, page 541:

senses.definition: Serving as an experiment; serving to experiment.

quotes.text: In its sixty-year history here, some 4,170 engines of the 4-6-0 type have been constructed. This is the vast sequel of that bold experimental step of the Highland Railway in 1894.
quotes.reference: 1954 November, Frank Hewitt, “The First Decade of British 4-6-0 Locomotives—1”, in Railway Magazine, page 747:

quotes.text: Numerous experimental tests and other observations have been offered in favor of animal mind reading, and although many scientists are skeptical, others assert that humans are not the only species capable of representing what others do and don’t perceive and know.
